scope.target: Workflow proportionality, task-value, and multi-Issue delivery-cohesion policy.
constraints: Task, Issue, commit, and file counts are signals rather than sole decision rules.
Provider state alone never authorizes work.
One cohesive delivery may bind multiple approved Issues without creating one workflow per Issue.
non_goals: Counting validation and closeout as artificial delivery tasks.

steps: Define the workflow-value test before workflow creation.
Define low-task review signals without numeric prohibition.
Define delivery cohesion and many-Issue-to-one-workflow binding.
Add representative deterministic cases and synchronize guidance.
execution.last_completed_step: Implemented canonical and portable workflow-value, low-task proportionality, and delivery-cohesion rules with deterministic coverage.
execution.next_action: Independent verification checks WFG-001 and WFG-002.

results.summary: Workflow mode now requires unique durable state plus a material execution condition; low-task workflows require proportionality review without task padding; multiple approved work items are grouped by delivery cohesion rather than Issue count.
results.residual_risk: Natural-language grouping remains model-in-loop; deterministic policy fixtures verify the required decision boundaries but cannot prove every future classification.
